properties.evidence: confirmation_ledger summed each capability's artifacts' accept histories by re-reading and re-classifying every accept for every capability, so an artifact realizing a hundred capabilities had its whole history walked a hundred times. Counted on the design's own data: 943,665 node reads classifying accepts where 4,001 accepting events' targets would do; timed: 17.4 s of loop_status's 23.2 s.
